description.text: Chinese-Language learner program (above half a year): The School of International Cultural Exchange of Beijing International Studies University is mainly responsible for the carrying out of Chinese courses teaching. It specializes in enrolling and teaching foreign students. The School of International Cultural Exchange of Beijing International Studies University provides the specialty of Chinese (including tourism route and finance route) for undergraduate program and also Chinese-Language learner program. The School of International Cultural Exchange of Beijing International Studies University is among the first batch of organizations that are authorized to hold the HSK Exam in Beijing. The HSK Exam is held three times annually in May, July and December. Basic Courses: Extensive Reading, Oral Chinese, Listening Comprehension, Dialogue, Newspaper Reading and Film Appreciation etc. Application Deadline for spring semester is December 31

duration.text: The Chinese-Language learner program at Beijing International Studies University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1250 USD/per semester ￥ 9000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Resume Written in Chinese and English You can download a template or sample from here

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above. 2.Under the age of 55 3.Applicants must Be in good health
